status: experimental, not live-validated; catalog, not a Kibana import object

hunts.name: Run or RunOnce registry value write
hunts.query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and winlog.provider_name : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code : "13" and (winlog.event_data.TargetObject : *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* or winlog.event_data.TargetObject : *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*)
hunts.note: Broad hunt; enable leading wildcards in the query context if required. Registry path matching is case-sensitive on some mappings. Validate case variants against actual events.

hunts.name: Registry value named EXEpath
hunts.query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and winlog.provider_name : "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code : "13" and winlog.event_data.TargetObject : *\\EXEpath
hunts.note: Supports a watchdog investigation, not family attribution by itself. Check field mapping/case.

hunts.name: Run write followed by a same-process connection
hunts.query:
sequence by host.name, winlog.event_data.ProcessGuid with maxspan=5m
  [any where event.dataset == "windows.sysmon_operational" and winlog.provider_name == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code == "13" and winlog.event_data.ProcessGuid != null and winlog.event_data.ProcessGuid != "" and winlog.event_data.ProcessGuid != "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" and winlog.event_data.TargetObject : ("*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*", "*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*")]
  [any where event.dataset == "windows.sysmon_operational" and winlog.provider_name == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code == "3"]
hunts.note: Use EQL, not the Discover KQL bar. Confirm keyword mappings and GUID fields. Different process handoffs and unavailable network events are known gaps.
